definitions.explanation: Eating food between main meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner), often referring to casual eating of snacks.

examples.japanese: {間食|かんしょく}を{控|ひか}えている。
ダイエット{中|ちゅう}は{間食|かんしょく}を{避|さ}けた{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: It's better to avoid snacking while dieting.

examples.japanese: 3{時|じ}の{間食|かんしょく}にお{菓子|かし}を{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I ate some sweets as an afternoon snack.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{間|かん} (between, interval) + {食|しょく} (eating) - eating during intervals between meals.

USAGE:
Often discussed in health and diet contexts. In Japanese culture, 3{時|じ}のおやつ (3 o'clock snack time) is traditional, especially for children.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {間食|かんしょく}をする - to snack
- {間食|かんしょく}を{控|ひか}える - to cut back on snacking
- {間食|かんしょく}を{止|や}める - to stop snacking

RELATED WORDS:
- おやつ - snack (more casual)
- {偏食|へんしょく} - picky eating
- {暴飲暴食|ぼういんぼうしょく} - binge eating and drinking
